artifact.core.armageddonsBlade.descripti:
{Armageddon's Blade}

Adds {+10} to all primary skills.

A hero with a Spell Book can cast {Armag. Blade}, a special Armageddon spell that costs {0} mana.

Increases damage dealt by fire spells by {50%}.

All allied creatures take {75%} less damage from fire spells.

Generates {+1} sulfur per day.
